title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Gas model and Flux.cpp implement conservative compressible perfect-gas flux and viscosity; reference conditions are case-derived in PhysicsSetup.cpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp handles mixed unstructured zones and BC data; Partition.cpp partitions the graph with METIS and distributes rank-local cells.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:172–256 assembles equal/opposite interior fluxes and divides by cell volume; pressure force sign in :295–305 contradicts the stated normal derivation.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Flux.cpp:20–98 implements Rusanov and Roe characteristic flux with entropy fix; five steady cases still fail to converge.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Boundary.cpp:12–70 applies characteristic farfield and reflected slip/no-slip ghost states; surface extraction outputs boundary averages. Flow/force credibility remains limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Residual.cpp:32–78,150–161 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss gradients and limited primitive reconstruction with positivity fallback; no demonstrated order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Residual.cpp:81–147 computes and exchanges face-based limiters; PhysicsSetup.cpp:70–78 selects Barth by default and spatial order two.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Flux.cpp:119 onward uses stress and heat flux; Residual.cpp:310–325 projects tangent wall traction. Force projection outputs at :341–349 lack qref normalization and pressure sign contradicts normal derivation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LUSGS.cpp:39–105 builds/inverts local block Jacobians and exchanges increments; TimeIntegrator implements CFL-controlled march. Five cases fail residual targets.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: TimeIntegrator.cpp:319–435 implements frozen-history BDF1/BDF2 and measures target misses, but submitted Re200 reaches t=3.03/300 with all 303 misses; unconditional periodic label at a hypothetical horizon is a source defect, not an actual false success.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Partition.cpp:274–315 keeps global mesh only on rank 0 before solve; report rank_comparison.csv shows np1/2/4/8 agreement at 300 bounded steps, not at steady convergence.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
